title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 13, section 1 (Delta/Surrey Dykes)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 13 Non-toxic Shot Only Areas (Section 10 (1) (d))
Delta/Surrey Dykes
1 Those portions of M.U. 2-4 within the Corporation of Delta being any dyke and the seaward or river side of any dyke, and within that part of the Corporation of the District of Surrey South of Highway 99 being any dyke facing Mud Bay and the seaward side of any said dyke. [en. B.C. Reg. 211/93, s. 13.]
